(async()=>{const A=(await import('/js/flight/aircraft.js')).AC, E=await import('/js/core/engine.js'); const out=[]; let last=performance.now(); await new Promise(res=>{ const f=()=>{ const now=performance.now(); const v=A.pos.clone().project(E.camera); out.push([now-last, (v.x+1)/2*innerWidth, (1-v.y)/2*innerHeight]); last=now; if(out.length<150) requestAnimationFrame(f); else res(); }; requestAnimationFrame(f); }); const d=out.slice(1); const dx=d.slice(1).map((p,i)=>Math.hypot(p[1]-d[i][1], p[2]-d[i][2])); const ft=d.map(p=>p[0]); const mean=a=>a.reduce((x,y)=>x+y,0)/a.length; const sd=a=>{const m=mean(a); return Math.sqrt(mean(a.map(x=>(x-m)**2)));}; return JSON.stringify({frames:d.length, ftMean:+mean(ft).toFixed(1), ftMax:+Math.max(...ft).toFixed(1), slow:ft.filter(x=>x>40).length, jitterMeanPx:+mean(dx).toFixed(2), jitterMaxPx:+Math.max(...dx).toFixed(1), jumpsOver5px:dx.filter(x=>x>5).length})})()
